name: Persona 4: Rise Gaiden
source: In this story-driven adventure, you play as the Protagonist, a high school student trapped in the surreal Dream World, where reality is distorted. Struggling with amnesia and distrust of even close friends, the Protagonist must save Rise Kujikawa, whose soul is being corrupted by an evil force. To uncover the truth and free them both, he must confront his deepest fears and unravel the mysteries of the Dream World.
translation: 在这部剧情驱动的冒险作品中，你将扮演一名受困于超现实扭曲空间“梦境世界”的高中生主角。在失忆的困扰下，甚至连昔日挚友都难以信赖的主角，必须设法拯救灵魂正遭邪恶力量侵蚀的久慈川理世。为了揭开真相并让两人重获自由，他必须直面内心最深处的恐惧，解开潜藏在梦境世界中的重重谜团。
